title: Flipping an Image
goal: Reverse each image row and invert every binary pixel.
strategy: For destination column c, read the mirrored source column and invert that bit exactly once.

phasePurposes.inspect: For destination column c, read the mirrored source column and invert that bit exactly once.
phasePurposes.update: Each row was reversed and each bit was inverted.
phasePurposes.done: Each row was reversed and each bit was inverted.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
